attributes.name: _subnet_mapping
attributes.purpose: AWS (edge.py, network_lb's): an NLB subnet_mapping for one subnet: an internal one's recorded frontend address when the subnet's CIDR holds it; a public one's first mapping the Elastic IP allocation its provider ref names.

attributes.purpose: AWS (edge.py, network_lb's): a TCP target group per port over the role's servers (instance targets, the policy's health check, stickiness and deregistration delay; a TCP check without a policy), its attachments and the NLB's TCP listener forwarding to it.

attributes.name: _service
attributes.purpose: A stable service name as AWS Terraform: what fronts it is the core's edge.gateways.front_choice (a note comment; the ALB before its cluster's gateway, ingress.gateway_front; else its role's servers), then an ALB with web ACL when its traffic policy terminates TLS (edge.alb_service) or a Network Load Balancer (edge.network_lb) in the deduplicated, name-sorted subnets of the role's servers and own compute groups; CloudFront when a CDN fronts it, else its Route 53 alias record. Groups register in its target groups themselves (compute_groups, target_group_arns).

attributes.name: _lb_frontend
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "m", "type": null, "required": true}, {"name": "svc", "type": null, "required": true}, {"name": "n", "type": null, "required": true}, {"name": "ip", "type": null, "required": true}, {"name": "internal", "type": null, "required": true}, {"name": "subnets", "type": null, "required": true}]
attributes.purpose: Azure: (data sources needed, frontend_ip_configuration body) of a service name's Standard load balancer: an internal one in the first of its targets' subnets (UNBOUND:<role>-subnet without one), its recorded address static else dynamic, zones 1-3; a public one the public IP read as data (public_ip_name).

attributes.name: _lb_port
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "n", "type": null, "required": true}, {"name": "port", "type": null, "required": true}, {"name": "spec", "type": null, "required": false, "default": "None"}]
attributes.purpose: Azure (edge.py, network_lb's): a load balancer probe and rule for one port: the probe's protocol/path/interval from the policy (TCP without one) on a product's own health port when declared, the rule's idle timeout (4-30 minutes) and SourceIP distribution as the policy asks.

attributes.name: _service
attributes.purpose: A stable service name as Azure Terraform: what fronts it is the core's edge.gateways.front_choice (a note comment; the Application Gateway before its cluster's gateway, ingress.gateway_front; else its role's servers), then an Application Gateway v2 with WAF policy when its traffic policy terminates TLS (edge.gateway_service) or a Standard load balancer (edge.network_lb; an internal frontend in the role's servers' subnets, else its own compute groups'); Front Door when a CDN fronts it; its (private) DNS A record. Scale sets join its pools themselves (compute_groups via _pools).

attributes.name: front_choice
attributes.purpose: What a cloud fronts a service name of environment m with, decided once for every cloud: ('note', text) when no front is rendered (its target role runs only on Kubernetes in a cluster without a gateway: note_comment(kubernetes_note); its exposure isn't recorded: exposure_unknown), ('gateway', the cluster's gateway binding: role_gateway) for a role run only on Kubernetes in a cluster with one, else ('servers', servers_with_role, (their subnets then the role's own compute groups' subnets, in order, repeats kept)).

attributes.name: network_lb
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "svc", "type": "Entry", "required": true}, {"name": "spec", "type": "EdgeSpec|None", "required": true}, {"name": "targets", "type": "tuple[Entry]", "required": true, "description": "the role's servers"}, {"name": "subnets", "type": "tuple[Entry]", "required": true, "description": "subnet bindings, deduplicated and sorted by name"}]
attributes.purpose: AWS: a Network Load Balancer for a service name whose TLS passes through (or with no policy): aws_lb in its subnet mappings (_subnet_mapping: an internal one's recorded address in the subnet holding it, a public one's first mapping the Elastic IP its provider ref names), TCP target groups/attachments/listeners per port over the role's servers (_listener: the policy's health check, stickiness, draining), probe_ingress for a product's own health port, Shield Advanced (shield) without a CDN, the planner's inspection note as a comment when the protection policy asks for request inspection.

attributes.name: network_lb
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "svc", "type": "Entry", "required": true}, {"name": "spec", "type": "EdgeSpec|None", "required": true}, {"name": "targets", "type": "tuple[Entry]", "required": true}, {"name": "subnets", "type": "tuple[Entry]", "required": true, "description": "servers' then compute groups' subnets in order (front_choice)"}]
attributes.purpose: Azure: a Standard load balancer for a service name whose TLS passes through (or with no policy): its frontend (_lb_frontend), the inspection note (no CDN) and ddos_note, azurerm_lb, a backend pool with the role's servers' NIC associations, and per port a probe and rule (_lb_port: the policy's health check on a product's own health port, idle timeout, SourceIP distribution).

attributes.purpose: Google Cloud: a passthrough network load balancer for a service name whose TLS passes through (or with no policy): the frontend's data sources, the inspection note, the zonal instance groups (given), a regional health check (the policy's protocol/path/thresholds, a product's own health port: _checked, _l4_tuning) and the firewall rule its probes need (_health_check_rule: a policy rule under the policy model), a regional backend service over backends (EXTERNAL: port_name, capacity) with affinity and draining, a forwarding rule (at most five ports, else all; internal placement), network_ddos on an external one.

attributes.description: Audit 3001 U14-02, rules 3002 + 2991. Core opsdir/opsdir/domains/edge: front_choice(m, svc) -> ('note', text) | ('gateway', gw) | ('servers', targets, subnets), next to gateways.role_gateway, replacing the same 9-line prelude in aws terraform.py _service (:140), azure (:172), gcp (:174). Each cloud maps the choice; its inline L4 balancer is extracted into network_lb(...) in its edge.py beside alb_service / gateway_service / application_lb. Output byte-identical (every service-name render on 3 clouds; CloudFormation and Bicep translations too). Boundary: opsdir/opsdir/domains/edge/ (+ its tests), the aws/azure/gcp adapters' terraform.py and edge.py (+ tests, READMEs), opsdir/README.md shared-API line. NOT azure arm_types/arm_render/check_jobs/rendered_state/arm.py (worker-2, task 516); NOT core contract/registry/environment/stack (worker-3, task 515).
